news.text: #Juve, #Lucumí In Hand#Suzuki closerFour reinforcements for #Spalletti: #Kessié and #Zirkzee are also on the list.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

"I STUDY #MESSI, I DREAM WITH #YILDIZ"#Alajbegovic ExclusiveThe Bosnian talent: "Many sought me, but you cannot say no to #Juve. #Pjanic also helped with my choice. It is honor that #DelPiero spoke about me. Kenan is a very strong player and a fantastic person. With #Spalletti, I learn every day." #Suzuki says yes! #Lucumí is close.[Front Page TuttoSport]

⏳🔛 "Starting today, we enter the heart of the matter for #Lucumí: #Juventus and #Bologna have drawn closer. The bianconeri are offering €20M, bonuses included, while the rossoblù want at least €20M + €3M in bonuses. There is still a minimal gap, but it is a gap that has truly thinned out after the contacts of the last few hours. Furthermore, there is a total agreement with the player: he is truly close."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇯🇵⁉️ "Starting today, #PSG will move to the formal part of the #Suzuki deal. At that point, it will be necessary to understand what will happen with the famous loan. If #Chevalier leaves, he could fight for the starting spot with #Safonov, otherwise he could go elsewhere. And this is where #Juventus comes into play, as they must make a choice. So pay attention: starting today, we are really entering the heart of the matter, the bianconeri are at the hour of the gong."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 "A Saudi club (other than #AlAhli, where he left) has been calling Franck #Kessié for weeks and is offering him a lot of money.#​Kessié recently rejected the Saudi offer responding: 'Thank you, but I'm waiting for #Juventus'.The Ivorian continues to give absolute priority to a possible transfer to the bianconero club. ​After trying to close the deal for the goalkeeper (priority 1) and the center-back #Lucumí, the midfield will be the next objective, and it remains to be seen if the #Juve management decides to move forward for #Kessié."[@MatteMoretto and @FabrizioRomano on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

🇦🇷🧐 "Nico #Gonzalez-#AtleticoMadrid is not a dead track, it is still standing. The Spanish club has had other priorities and furthermore the two clubs are still a bit too distant. I believe the Spanish strategy might be to wait and understand if the price could be lowered. For the sporting sector of the Colchoneros, however, he is definitely a priority: they want to try to bring him home."[Matteo Moretto - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
Dusan deleted everything about Juventus on his Instagram.

🚨 Excl. - Jhon #Lucumì to #Juventus from #Bologna is at the final stage for €20M + 10% on the future sale. Contract until 2031 (€2,5M/year). Lucumì only wants to join #Juve and has turned down two Premier League and two Super Lig Clubs to wait and to join Bianconeri[Nico Schira]

🇨🇦❌ "Regarding #David, at this moment, I am not aware of any advanced discussion with #AstonVilla, they have not made a move either with #Juventus or with the agents. The Canadian's situation remains absolutely quiet. It is clear that if, between now and at the end of the mercato, an important offer were to arrive, it could be an opportunity to cash in and perhaps open other tracks."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
#Lucumí-#Juve will close by the weekend. 20M to #Bologna and, as told in recent days, without players in exchange. For #Lucumí, a 5-year contract.@sportmediaset[Orazio Accomando]

🇨🇴⏳ "The #Lucumí deal is closing and has been defined at €17/18M + bonuses, to reach €20M and perhaps even slightly exceed this figure, net of the considerations that will be made regarding #Cabal. #Juventus never let go of him: it was right to wait for the end of the World Cup, the clause that was expiring and the discount. He said 'no' to at least 5 Turkish clubs, a couple of English ones, #AlHilal sought him and #Inter inquired about him, but he only wanted the bianconeri."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🔚👋 #DiGregorio's adventure at #Juventus could now be nearing its end: a hostile environment has been created. A sale can be useful to welcome a more reliable goalkeeper and for him to rebuild himself elsewhere. The #Valencia option, on loan with a conditional obligation to buy, is the most probable. The bianconeri aim to pocket €15M, the dialogue between the clubs is underway and the player will speak about it in the coming hours. Meanwhile, #Suzuki remains in pole position, with #Trubin and #Vicario in the background.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

😬 #ZIRKZEE DIFFICULT🗣 Fabrizio Romano and Matteo Moretto on YT:"Leaving aside that #Massara likes the player very much, today there is a big issue that is blocking this discussion, #ManUnited. The player is still a starter, he plays in the Champions League.... Going to sign him on loan with an option to buy becomes complicated.Either #Juve finds a way, perhaps a sale to be able to do an obligation to buy, or today talking about #Zirkzee-#Juve becomes difficult.There is still a big gap between the clubs. Many, many steps are still missing."[@AverageJuventinoGuy]

🔜🏁 JOHN #LUCUMI 🗣 Fabrizio Romano on YT:"A locked-down agreement exists between #Lucumí's agency and #Juventus. #Juve proposed #Cabal as a player in exchange. #Bologna prefers only cash at this moment. #Juventus and #Bologna are increasingly closer.From what I gather, the closing of the deal could take place over the weekend. From tomorrow onward, any movement is good to cross the finish line. #Juventus has already set a new appointment with #Bologna tomorrow to try to close the deal.#Bologna's request is 20mln + 3 in bonuses. #Juve is offering a bit less (20 bonuses included). #Juventus is close, very close..."[@AverageJuventinoGuy]

🧐❗️"I am not at all convinced that #Juventus is going to close the #Zirkzee deal in the event #David leaves. It is a name to keep in mind and he can be a good opportunity on loan with an option to buy, but the management is moving secretely on forwards: other names could emerge."[Romeo Agresti - IlBianconero via @juventusinsidernews]

🇨🇴🆙 "#Juventus's idea is to close the #Lucumí deal by the end of the week/beginning of next week. #Bologna wants €25M, the bianconeri want under €20M, but all parties are very optimistic. He is the defender most requested by #Spalletti because he is not satisfied with how the team builds up from the back."[Romeo Agresti - IlBianconero via @juventusinsidernews]

🧤🧐 "The contact between #Juventus-#PSG for #Suzuki has taken place. Let's see if updates arrive in the evening, seeing that news always come at the end of the day, but these are hours of work for the Japanese. Continuous dialogues with his entourage. We always keep a bit of #Vicario on the radar. If we were to close the deal for the now ex #Parma goalkeeper, I say to pay attention again to #Alisson for next year."[Romeo Agresti - IlBianconero via @juventusinsidernews]

GJustjuve .@juventusfc, #Lucumi is one step away: a deal of 20 million euros, bonuses included. [Di Marzio] https://t.me/GJustjuve/71071ℹ️ #Juventus is insisting for #Lucumí, who is now one step away for €20M, bonuses included. A few aspects remain to be defined between the clubs before organizing the travel and medicals, confidence in completing everything by the end of the week. A contract of 4 year + option. The loan of #Cabal, at least initially, will not be part of this deal.[Di Marzio via @juventusinsidernews]
#Lucumí-#Juventus ⌛️ the only name mentioned for the bianconero defense for 50 days. And above all the name at the very top. He said no to at least 5 offers to wait for #Juve[Alfredo Pedullà]
#Juventus-#Lucumí: 17–18 million plus bonuses to reach 20, the figures from last night.[Alfredo Pedullà]
